final_lessons: On this bigram task, Adam at lr 3e-4 with wider transformer capacity can beat aggressive RMSprop even in an 80-step budget.
For deeper transformers on this bigram task, Adam at lr 0.003 can overshoot while RMSprop around lr 0.001 is safer.
Large transformers with AdamW or Adam around lr 3e-4 are strong on this task when alternatives use slow SGD or Adagrad settings.
Adagrad at lr 0.003 with a large/deep transformer can be strong on this bigram task and may beat high-lr Adam.
Adam at lr 3e-4 with 128-wide transformer capacity is a reliable choice against RMSprop 0.003 or SGD momentum on this dataset.
AdamW at lr 0.001 can be very strong for a 64-wide two-layer transformer when feed-forward width is sufficient.
Plain SGD at lr 0.01 and AdamW at lr 1e-4 both undertrain compared with large AdamW at lr 3e-4.
Low-learning-rate SGD variants stay badly undertrained, so a modest Adam lr 3e-4 model should usually beat them.
A 128-wide transformer can make RMSprop lr 0.0003 highly competitive, beating smaller Adagrad lr 0.003 despite the lower step size.
AdamW at lr 0.01 can work for a shallow 128-wide transformer and beat deeper RMSprop lr 0.001 in this setting.
